# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.4 D4-1 phase 1, the Latin world: crusades and the Knights. Generated by gen_latin.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# 2026-11-19 v6.4 D4-1 phase 2 (Alexandria, Smyrna's fall, Varna and the Hexamilion: events 4, 8-12, 14; world steps W-1 to W-3) added to this file by the same generator.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 17); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): close in 1525, bookkeeping, then at most one event in a calm, free month.
oe_lat_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_off } }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1525.1.1 } set_variable = oe_lat_off }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_lat_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
            oe_lat_book = yes
            oe_lat_world = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_lat_calm = yes oe_ml_free = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 13 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = 50 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 2 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = 30 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 3 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_8 = yes } random = { chance = 50 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 8 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_7 = yes } random = { chance = 30 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 7 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 5 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_12 = yes } random = { chance = 25 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 12 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_10 = yes } random = { chance = 50 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 10 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_9 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_9 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 9 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_4 = yes } random = { chance = 30 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 4 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 0 oe_lat_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_lat_pick value = 1 } } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 13 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 13 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 2 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 2 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 3 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 3 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 8 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_8 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 8 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 7 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 7 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 5 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_5 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 5 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 12 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_12 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 12 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 10 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_10 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 10 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 9 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_9 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 9 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_4 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 4 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_pick = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_1 value = 1 } oe_lat_fire = { n = 1 } }
                remove_variable = oe_lat_pick
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends an event of the monthly check (the one-off events .1 .5 are marked fired just before, above).
oe_lat_fire = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_st value = $n$ }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.$n$
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Bookkeeping, no pop-ups (design 3.3, phase-1 part).
oe_lat_book = {
    # The crusade: its target and temporal leader are recorded once; when it is gone, a crusade we helped opens the
    # buy-back window of .3 (10 years) and the line forgets it.
    if = {
        limit = { exists = international_organization:crusade }
        international_organization:crusade = {
            international_organization_target ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_bt }
            random_country_with_special_status_of_type = { type = crusade_temporal_leader save_scope_as = oe_lat_bl }
        }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_cru_t } exists = scope:oe_lat_bt } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_cru_t value = scope:oe_lat_bt } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_cru_l } exists = scope:oe_lat_bl } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_cru_l value = scope:oe_lat_bl } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_lat_cru_t has_variable = oe_lat_cru_seen has_variable = oe_lat_cru_side } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_cru_side ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_handback years = 10 } }
        debug_log = "oe_lat crusade over: side [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_cru')|0], places kept [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_held')|0]"
        remove_variable = oe_lat_cru_t
        remove_variable = oe_lat_cru_l
        remove_variable = oe_lat_cru_seen
        remove_variable = oe_lat_cru_side
    }
    # Places left behind by a crusade: the window closes when none is still kept; the list is cleared when no crusade
    # runs and no window is open.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_handback NOT = { oe_lat_any_kept = yes } } remove_variable = oe_lat_handback }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable_list = oe_lat_held NOT = { exists = international_organization:crusade } NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_handback } }
        oe_lat_clear_held = yes
    }
    # Smyrna in Latin hands (the vanilla Smyrniote crusade, or anyone Catholic): recorded for .1.
    # Phase 2: lost to a non-Christian afterwards (not by W-1): oe_lat_smyrna_fell = 2, the month in oe_lat_smyrna_at (.8).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_latin } location:smyrna = { owner ?= { religion = religion:catholic } } }
        set_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_latin
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_latin
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_fell }
            location:smyrna = { owner ?= { NOT = { religion.group = religion_group:christian } } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_smyrna_fell value = 2 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_smyrna_at value = var:oe_lat_m }
        debug_log = "oe_lat: Smyrna lost by the Latins (2)"
    }
    # The Morea in the Knights' keeping: months counted; closed silently in 1410 or when the Knights are gone, and five
    # years after .7 c.
    if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_morea ?= 1 } change_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea_m add = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lat_morea ?= 1 OR = { current_date >= 1410.1.1 NOT = { country_exists = c:KNI } } }
        oe_lat_morea_end = yes
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_morea ?= 4 NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_morea_ext } } oe_lat_morea_end = yes }
    # Phase 2. Varna: months since the bull (until the Straits), since the defeat (until .12); W-2's wait after Nicopolis.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_varna_m NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_straits } } change_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna_m add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_hex_m NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_12 } } change_variable = { name = oe_lat_hex_m add = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_byd_nicopolis NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_nic_ransom } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_nic_m } change_variable = { name = oe_lat_nic_m add = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_lat_nic_m value = 0 } }
    }
    # Phase 2. Events that can no longer come: .4 and .8 24 months after their news, .10 and .12 from 1449.1.1; the
    # Varna events are void when the bull's window closes without the premise (before .9 is marked given up below).
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_4 } oe_lat_alex_seen = yes var:oe_lat_m > oe_lat_alex_end } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_8 } has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_fell var:oe_lat_m > oe_lat_smyrna_end } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_8 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_varna NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_straits } NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_10 } current_date >= 1449.1.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_10 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_hex_m NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_12 } current_date >= 1449.1.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_12 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_9 } NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_varna_void } var:oe_lat_m > 1320 NOT = { oe_lat_varna_pre = yes } }
        set_variable = oe_lat_varna_void
        debug_log = "oe_lat: the Varna events are void (the Ottomans are not strong enough, or the City is lost)"
    }
    # Windows that passed without their event.
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_1 } var:oe_lat_m > 192 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_5 } var:oe_lat_m > 804 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_9 } var:oe_lat_m > 1320 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_fired_9 value = 2 } }
}

# BYZ scope. Pay / gain $months$ months of trade and tax income; pay them to c:$who$ (who gets the same gold).
oe_lat_pay = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -$months$ } }
oe_lat_gain = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = $months$ } }
oe_lat_pay_to = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_lat_amt value = oe_lat_m$months$ }
    add_gold = { value = scope:oe_lat_amt multiply = -1 }
    c:$who$ ?= { add_gold = scope:oe_lat_amt }
}
# BYZ scope. .1: the choice on the Holy League ($v$: 1 member, 2 the old pact with the Turks, 0 trade only). oe_lat_league
# lasts 10 years (oe_lat_west_will reads it); oe_lat_league_was keeps the choice for the chronicle.
oe_lat_set_league = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_league value = $v$ years = 10 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_league_was value = $v$ }
}

# BYZ scope. The Peloponnese (theme region 14): every place of ours and of our subjects there.
oe_lat_morea_mod = {
    every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 14 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $years$ mode = replace } }
    every_subject = { every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 14 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $years$ mode = replace } } }
}
oe_lat_morea_clear = {
    every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 14 } oe_lat_morea_unmod = yes }
    every_subject = { every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 14 } oe_lat_morea_unmod = yes } }
}
# Location scope.
oe_lat_morea_unmod = {
    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_lat_knights_morea } remove_location_modifier = oe_lat_knights_morea }
    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_lat_mistra_unrest } remove_location_modifier = oe_lat_mistra_unrest }
}
# BYZ scope. The Morea comes back from the Knights (.7 a/b, or silently in 1410, without the Knights, after .7 c).
oe_lat_morea_end = {
    oe_lat_morea_clear = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea value = 2 }
    remove_variable = oe_lat_morea_m
    remove_variable = oe_lat_morea_ext
    debug_log = "oe_lat morea: back from the Knights"
}

# BYZ scope. The hidden worker oe_lat.90 (var:oe_lat_do): 1 mark the crusaders (.2 a), 2 join the crusade (.2 d),
# 3 buy back (.3 a), 4 claim (.3 b), 5 leave them (.3 c), 6 the Knights take the Morea (.5 a), 7 bought back early
# (.6 a), 8 wait (.6 b), 9 enforce (.6 c), 10 redeemed (.7 a b), 11 five more years (.7 c), 12 refused (.5 c).
# Phase 2: 13 the Straits and the Morea (.9 a), 14 withdraw and pay (.12 a), 15 the wall falls (.14), 16 tribute (.12 c).
oe_lat_do_job = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 1 } oe_lat_mark_crusaders = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 2 } oe_lat_join_crusade = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 3 } oe_lat_buy_back = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 4 } oe_lat_reclaim = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 5 } oe_lat_bulwark = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 6 } oe_lat_morea_entrust = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 7 }
        oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = 15 }
        oe_lat_morea_end = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 8 }
        oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = -5 }
        location:mystras = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_lat_mistra_unrest years = 3 mode = replace } }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 9 } oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = -15 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 10 } oe_lat_morea_end = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 11 }
        oe_lat_morea_mod = { mod = oe_lat_knights_morea years = 5 }
        oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = -10 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea_ext years = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 12 }
        oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea value = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 13 }
        oe_lat_athens_cb = yes
        oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = 5 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 14 } oe_lat_athens_cb_off = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 15 } oe_lat_hexamilion_fall = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_do ?= 16 } oe_lat_tribute = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_lat_do
}
# BYZ scope. .2 a: the members of the crusade are marked as crusaders for 15 years (on_action oe_lat_took_location).
oe_lat_mark_crusaders = {
    international_organization:crusade ?= {
        every_international_organization_member = { limit = { NOT = { tag = BYZ } } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_crusader years = 15 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .2 d: a Catholic empire joins the crusade.
oe_lat_join_crusade = {
    international_organization:crusade ?= { add_country_to_international_organization = c:BYZ }
    oe_lat_mark_crusaders = yes
}
# Location scope. Marks this place as left behind by the crusade, held by $who$.
oe_lat_mark = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_holder value = $who$ }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = oe_lat_held target = this } } }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = oe_lat_held target = this }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_lat_h set. Every listed place recorded for that holder leaves the list.
oe_lat_unmark = {
    every_in_global_list = {
        variable = oe_lat_held
        limit = { var:oe_lat_holder ?= scope:oe_lat_h }
        remove_variable = oe_lat_holder
        add_to_temporary_list = oe_lat_drop
    }
    every_in_list = { list = oe_lat_drop remove_list_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_held target = this } }
}
# BYZ scope. Every listed place leaves the list.
oe_lat_clear_held = {
    every_in_global_list = { variable = oe_lat_held limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_holder } remove_variable = oe_lat_holder }
    clear_global_variable_list = oe_lat_held
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_lat_h set (.3 immediate). How many places that holder keeps, for the text.
oe_lat_count_h = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_h_n value = 0 }
    every_in_global_list = {
        variable = oe_lat_held
        limit = { oe_lat_held_ok = yes var:oe_lat_holder ?= scope:oe_lat_h }
        root = { change_variable = { name = oe_lat_h_n add = 1 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .3 a: buy back, nearest first, up to three places, two months of income each while the money lasts.
oe_lat_buy_back = {
    var:oe_lat_h ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_h }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_h }
        ordered_in_global_list = {
            variable = oe_lat_held
            limit = { oe_lat_held_ok = yes var:oe_lat_holder ?= scope:oe_lat_h }
            order_by = oe_lat_near
            max = 3
            check_range_bounds = no
            if = {
                limit = { root = { oe_lat_can_pay = { months = 2 } } }
                root = { oe_lat_pay = { months = 2 } }
                change_location_owner = root
                add_core = root
            }
        }
        scope:oe_lat_h = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_b_bought target = root } }
        oe_lat_unmark = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .3 b: a casus belli to restore the Roman borders against the holder.
oe_lat_reclaim = {
    var:oe_lat_h ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_h }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_h }
        add_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_lat_h type = casus_belli:cb_restore_roman_borders years = 10 }
        scope:oe_lat_h = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_b_reclaim target = root } }
        oe_lat_unmark = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .3 c: the Latins keep them.
oe_lat_bulwark = {
    var:oe_lat_h ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_h }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_h }
        scope:oe_lat_h = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_b_bulwark target = root } }
        oe_lat_unmark = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .5 a: the Knights take the Morea in trust. No change of owner (decision 160): their garrison is a location
# modifier for 5 years, theme loyalty -10. An AI KNI pays four months of our income, at most what it has; a player KNI
# is not charged. .6 follows in 120-360 days.
oe_lat_morea_entrust = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KNI c:KNI = { is_ai = yes } }
        save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_lat_amt value = oe_lat_kni_price }
        c:KNI = { add_gold = { value = scope:oe_lat_amt multiply = -1 } }
        add_gold = scope:oe_lat_amt
    }
    else = { oe_lat_gain = { months = 4 } }
    oe_lat_morea_mod = { mod = oe_lat_knights_morea years = 5 }
    oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = -10 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_morea_m value = 0 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_lat.6 days = { 120 360 } }
    debug_log = "oe_lat morea: entrusted to the Knights"
}

# BYZ scope. One debug_log line with the readouts (test page, observer logs); phase 2 adds a second line.
oe_lat_log = { debug_log = "oe_lat will=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_west_will')|0] league=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_league')|0] cru=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_cru')|0] held=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_held')|0] morea=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_morea')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_morea_m')|0] f1=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_f1')|0] f5=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_f5')|0] st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_st')|0] flags=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_flags')|0]" oe_lat_log2 = yes }
oe_lat_log2 = { debug_log = "oe_lat2 varna=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_varna')|0] vres=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_vres')|0] vm=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_v_m')|0] hex=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_hex')|0] ev2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_ev2')|0] world=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_world_flags')|0] straits%=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_straits_chance')|0] varna%=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_varna_chance')|0]" }

# ---- test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. The pope calls a crusade against the Ottomans with vanilla crusade_effect (the pope is also its temporal
# leader). Only for testing .2; phase 3 (.91) will build crusades the design's way.
oe_lat_test_crusade = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:PAP country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { exists = international_organization:crusade } }
        c:TUR = { save_scope_as = oe_lat_tt }
        c:PAP = { crusade_effect = { target = scope:oe_lat_tt } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. One former Roman place of an AI Catholic country at peace with us is marked as left behind by a crusade,
# and the buy-back window opens for two years (for testing .3).
oe_lat_test_held = {
    random_country = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = yes
            religion = religion:catholic
            NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ }
            NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = c:BYZ }
            any_owned_location = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
        }
        save_scope_as = oe_lat_tw
        random_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region } oe_lat_mark = { who = scope:oe_lat_tw } }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_handback years = 2 }
}
# BYZ scope. Forget this line's state, so its events can be tested again.
oe_lat_test_reset = {
    oe_lat_morea_clear = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable_list = oe_lat_held } oe_lat_clear_held = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_lat_league_member } remove_country_modifier = oe_lat_league_member }
    remove_variable = oe_lat_fired_1
    remove_variable = oe_lat_fired_5
    remove_variable = oe_lat_league
    remove_variable = oe_lat_league_was
    remove_variable = oe_lat_cru_seen
    remove_variable = oe_lat_cru_side
    remove_variable = oe_lat_cru_t
    remove_variable = oe_lat_cru_l
    remove_variable = oe_lat_handback
    remove_variable = oe_lat_morea
    remove_variable = oe_lat_morea_m
    remove_variable = oe_lat_morea_ext
    remove_variable = oe_lat_rhodes_cd
    remove_variable = oe_lat_st
    remove_variable = oe_lat_h
    remove_variable = oe_lat_h_n
    remove_variable = oe_lat_off
    # phase 2 (world changes are not undone; the records are cleared so that the steps can be tested again)
    remove_variable = oe_lat_fired_4
    remove_variable = oe_lat_fired_8
    remove_variable = oe_lat_fired_9
    remove_variable = oe_lat_fired_10
    remove_variable = oe_lat_fired_12
    remove_variable = oe_lat_varna
    remove_variable = oe_lat_varna_m
    remove_variable = oe_lat_varna_void
    remove_variable = oe_lat_warned
    remove_variable = oe_lat_hex_m
    remove_variable = oe_lat_hex
    remove_variable = oe_lat_athens_cb
    remove_variable = oe_lat_nic_m
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_fell } remove_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_fell }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_at } remove_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_at }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_straits } remove_global_variable = oe_lat_straits }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_varna_res } remove_global_variable = oe_lat_varna_res }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_nic_ransom } remove_global_variable = oe_lat_nic_ransom }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_alex_sacked } remove_global_variable = oe_lat_alex_sacked }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_lat_alex_trade } remove_country_modifier = oe_lat_alex_trade }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_lat_varna_glory } remove_country_modifier = oe_lat_varna_glory }
}

# BYZ scope. Imperial Authority $amount$ (as oe_mo_auth).
oe_lat_auth = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } } }

# BYZ scope, monthly. World steps (design 3.6): only while the countries involved are AI; no pop-up, no lock.
# (phase 4: P-1, the papacy back in Rome, goes here too)
oe_lat_world = {
    # W-1 Timur and Smyrna (months 786-828, 25% a month, sure in the last): Smyrna taken from the
    # Latins, or only their harbour castle (the story version).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_fell } var:oe_lat_m >= 786 var:oe_lat_m <= 828 oe_lat_timur_near = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_lat_w1_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_w1 oe_lat_w1_run = yes } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_lat_w1n_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_w1 oe_lat_w1n_run = yes } }
    }
    # W-2 after Nicopolis: 9 months after C7's battle (global oe_byd_nicopolis), once.
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_byd_nicopolis NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_nic_ransom } has_variable = oe_lat_nic_m var:oe_lat_nic_m >= 9 }
        oe_lat_w2_run = yes
    }
    # W-3 Alexandria (months 345-354, 35% a month, sure in the last): the fallback while W5 does not run
    # (W5 sets oe_emd_live in its first month; hook E of w5-emd_实施.md).
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_alex_sacked }
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_live }
            var:oe_lat_m >= 345 var:oe_lat_m <= 354
            oe_lat_w3_ok = yes
        }
        random = { chance = oe_lat_ch_w3 oe_lat_w3_run = yes }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. W-1: Timur takes Smyrna from the Latins (1402.12). It goes back to Aydin (an AI, outside the empire's side;
# Timur restored the emirs), else to the strongest AI Muslim neighbour of Smyrna; else the owner stays. Looted 5 years.
oe_lat_w1_run = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:AYD c:AYD = { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } c:AYD = { save_scope_as = oe_lat_smy_to } }
    else = {
        location:smyrna = {
            ordered_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { owner ?= { is_ai = yes religion.group = religion_group:muslim NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
                order_by = oe_lat_owner_army
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_lat_smy_to }
            }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_smy_to } location:smyrna = { change_location_owner = scope:oe_lat_smy_to } }
    location:smyrna = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 5 mode = replace } }
    oe_lat_smyrna_falls = { v = 1 }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step W-1: Smyrna has fallen (1) in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lat_m').GetValue|0]"
}
# BYZ scope. W-1, the story version: only the Latins' harbour castle falls; the town is looted 3 years.
oe_lat_w1n_run = {
    location:smyrna = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } }
    oe_lat_smyrna_falls = { v = 3 }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step W-1: Smyrna has fallen (3) in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lat_m').GetValue|0]"
}
oe_lat_smyrna_falls = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_smyrna_fell value = $v$ }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_smyrna_at value = var:oe_lat_m }
}
# BYZ scope. W-2 after Nicopolis (design 3.6), AI countries only. A defeat: Burgundy ransoms the Count of Nevers (six
# months of its income, at most what it has; prestige -10), Hungary -10, France -5. A victory (C7's global
# oe_byd_nicopolis = 2): Hungary +15, Burgundy +10. Anything else counts as a defeat (the test button, before C7 rolls).
oe_lat_w2_run = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_byd_nicopolis global_var:oe_byd_nicopolis = 2 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HUN c:HUN = { is_ai = yes } } c:HUN = { add_prestige = 15 } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:BUR c:BUR = { is_ai = yes } } c:BUR = { add_prestige = 10 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_nic_ransom value = 2 }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:BUR c:BUR = { is_ai = yes } }
            c:BUR = {
                save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_lat_amt value = oe_lat_ransom }
                add_gold = { value = scope:oe_lat_amt multiply = -1 }
                add_prestige = -10
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HUN c:HUN = { is_ai = yes } } c:HUN = { add_prestige = -10 } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:FRA c:FRA = { is_ai = yes } } c:FRA = { add_prestige = -5 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_nic_ransom value = 1 }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step W-2 after Nicopolis ([GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_world_flags')|0])"
}
# BYZ scope. W-3 Alexandria, the fallback (design 3.6): looted 3 years, the Mamluks' anger at Cyprus, Cyprus +10 prestige.
# The month goes into the global oe_lat_alex_sacked (.4 waits up to 24 months; W5 reads the flag, its hook G).
oe_lat_w3_run = {
    location:alexandria = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } }
    c:MAM = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_bw_alexandria target = c:CYP } }
    c:CYP = { add_prestige = 10 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_alex_sacked value = var:oe_lat_m }
    debug_log = "oe_lat world step W-3: Alexandria sacked in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_lat_m').GetValue|0]"
}

# BYZ scope. .11 on entry: the battle is rolled (global oe_lat_varna_res: 1 defeat, 2 victory) and the world takes note.
# A victory: the Ottomans get oe_lat_varna_tur, an AI Hungary +15 prestige (the empire's own gains are in the option).
# A defeat: the sultan's wrath if the empire helped (.9 a or b), an AI Hungary -15 and Poland -10 prestige; after .9 a
# the count towards .12 starts.
oe_lat_varna_battle = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna_res value = 1 }
    random = { chance = oe_lat_varna_chance set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna_res value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_varna_res global_var:oe_lat_varna_res = 2 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_lat_varna_tur years = 5 mode = replace } } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HUN c:HUN = { is_ai = yes } } c:HUN = { add_prestige = 15 } }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_lat_varna ?= 1 var:oe_lat_varna ?= 2 } } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lat_b_sultan_wrath target = c:BYZ } } } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HUN c:HUN = { is_ai = yes } } c:HUN = { add_prestige = -15 } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:POL c:POL = { is_ai = yes } } c:POL = { add_prestige = -10 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_lat_varna ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_hex_m value = 0 } }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_lat Varna: result [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_rd_vres')|0], chance [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_varna_chance')|0]"
}
# BYZ scope. .9 a: a casus belli on the holder of Athens (not the empire's side, not the Ottomans), 10 years; kept in
# oe_lat_athens_cb so that .12 a can give it up again.
oe_lat_athens_cb = {
    location:athens = { owner ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_ath } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_ath scope:oe_lat_ath = { NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } NOT = { tag = TUR } } }
        add_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_lat_ath type = casus_belli:cb_restore_roman_borders years = 10 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_lat_athens_cb value = scope:oe_lat_ath }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .12 a: the casus belli of .9 a is given up (if it is still there).
oe_lat_athens_cb_off = {
    var:oe_lat_athens_cb ?= { save_scope_as = oe_lat_ath }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_lat_ath has_casus_belli_of_type_on = { type = casus_belli:cb_restore_roman_borders target = scope:oe_lat_ath } }
        remove_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_lat_ath type = casus_belli:cb_restore_roman_borders }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_athens_cb } remove_variable = oe_lat_athens_cb }
}
# BYZ scope. .14 (the wall falls): B5's three steps of oe_mo.7 (the wall torn down, oe_mo_hexamilion gone, the region
# ravaged 5 years, here for our subjects' places too), theme loyalty -10.
oe_lat_hexamilion_fall = {
    location:corinth = { destroy_all_buildings_of_type = building_type:hexamilion_wall }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mo_hexamilion } remove_global_variable = oe_mo_hexamilion }
    oe_lat_morea_mod = { mod = oe_mo_ravaged years = 5 }
    oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = -10 }
    debug_log = "oe_lat: the Hexamilion has fallen"
}
# BYZ scope. .12 c: tribute to the sultan (B3's buying-peace agreement), unless one is already in force.
oe_lat_tribute = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } } }
        c:TUR = { save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t }
        oe_ttb_peace_sign = yes
    }
}

# ---- phase 2 test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. .8 with a fall on record (only the harbour castle, if there is none).
oe_lat_test_8 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_fell } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_smyrna_fell value = 3 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_smyrna_at value = oe_ml_month_now }
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.8
}
# BYZ scope. .10 (a few ships at .9 if not chosen yet; the Straits and Varna rolled again; .11 follows in 25-40 days).
oe_lat_test_10 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_varna } } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna value = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna_m value = 12 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_varna_res } remove_global_variable = oe_lat_varna_res }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.10
}
# BYZ scope. .11 now (the Straits crossed if not rolled yet; Varna rolled again).
oe_lat_test_11 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lat_varna } } set_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_straits } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_straits value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_varna_res } remove_global_variable = oe_lat_varna_res }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.11
}
# BYZ scope. .12 after a defeat at Varna with the empire's full help (needs Corinth and the wall).
oe_lat_test_12 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna value = 2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_varna_res value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_straits } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_lat_straits value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_lat_fired_12 } remove_variable = oe_lat_fired_12 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lat.12
}
# BYZ scope. The world steps without their dates (and W-1 without Timur, W-2 without its wait, W-3 without W5's yield);
# every country involved must still be AI.
oe_lat_test_w1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_smyrna_fell } debug_log = "oe_lat test: W-1 is already recorded; reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_lat_w1_ok = yes } oe_lat_w1_run = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_lat_w1n_ok = yes } oe_lat_w1n_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lat test: W-1 cannot run now (Smyrna is not held by an AI Catholic country, and .1 was not answered)" }
}
oe_lat_test_w2 = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_nic_ransom } debug_log = "oe_lat test: W-2 is already recorded; reset first" }
    else = { oe_lat_w2_run = yes }
}
oe_lat_test_w3 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_lat_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_alex_sacked } debug_log = "oe_lat test: W-3 is already recorded; reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_lat_w3_ok = yes } oe_lat_w3_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_lat test: W-3 cannot run now (a player, a war, or Alexandria not Mamluk)" }
}
